rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for recurring, habitual, or colloquially emphatic ‘always’.

example.english: You always go to bed so late.
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 je6 sin1 fan3

rows.note: Use 一直 for an unbroken state or action continuing from a starting point, rather than a recurring habit.

example.english: I have always been waiting for you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dang2 gan2 nei5

rows.note: Use 永遠 for an enduring or timeless ‘always’, especially when it means ‘forever’.

example.jyutping: ngo5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 mong4 gei3 nei5

rows.note: Use 大不了 when ‘always’ means a fallback or last resort, as in ‘if necessary’ or ‘at worst’.

example.english: If there’s no car home, I can always walk back.
example.traditional: 冇車返屋企，大不了我行返去。
example.jyutping: mou5 ce1 faan1 uk1 kei2 daai6 bat1 liu5 ngo5 haang4 faan1 heoi3
